summary: Rewrite g, k through atPlaces ∘ embedGL and apply the action of pair Weil operators on names.

steps.claim: Write the matrices g and k inside f̃(k⁻¹·S·g), f̃ = liftFn(f), as atPlaces(P, embedGL(·)) of their embeddings.

Testing on a vector, the pair Weil operator of elements supported on P ∪ P̄ sends the name of a function F to the name of F(k⁻¹·S·g) times characters of the determinants at P (Space.pairWeil_name_on; P disjoint from P̄).
The scalar characters are those of detCharAt; a field computation identifies them.
